```{r}
cell_ID <- c("CX1", "CX2")
treated <- c(TRUE, FALSE)
numcells_before <- c(5415, 8123)
numcells_after <- c(1432, 7543)

all_my_pets <- c("dog", "horse", "guinea pig", "chicken", "cat")
animal1 <- all_my_pets[4]
print(animal1)
```
```{r}
celldata <- tibble(
  row1 = cell_ID,
  row2 = treated,
  row3 = numcells_before,
  row4 = numcells_after
  
)
gt(celldata)
```
